name: problem-scene
description: Hub problem section: centred heading and lede over two overlapping photos with four coloured chips around them, then a panda CTA bar. Live: #ap-gov-problem on the industry hubs.

background.description: Soft colour-wash image behind the section.

images.description: Two photos. Each: image, alt. Each may carry x, y, w, h (% of the scene) to place and size it; the scene then takes its height from scene_height.

chips.description: Up to five chips (blue, red, green, yellow placements, then a fifth). Each: text, tone; icon (URL) or icon_svg; optional desktop placement left, right, top (CSS lengths, auto, or calc/min/max).

scene_height.description: Height of the photo scene in px. 0 keeps the default 260.
